axioms.subject: HybridSatelliteTerrestrialNetwork
axioms.evidence: To tackle spectrum scarcity, spectrum sharing is studied for a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network where satellite links share the same group of time-slotted subcarriers with terrestrial links opportunistically.

axioms.subject: TimeScaleAdaptableSpectrumSharingFramework
axioms.evidence: a time-scale-adaptable spectrum sharing framework is proposed based on a satellite-terrestrial cooperation time scale

axioms.subject: FullFrequencyReuse
axioms.evidence: For generality, it is assumed that both full and partial frequency reuse could be adopted among the base stations (BSs)

axioms.subject: StatisticalChannelStateInformation
axioms.evidence: Relying on only statistical channel state information (CSI), joint link scheduling and power control are explored

axioms.subject: MixedIntegerProgrammingProblem
axioms.evidence: To solve the complicated mixed integer programming (MIP) problem, a low-complexity spectrum sharing scheme is presented

axioms.subject: LowComplexitySpectrumSharingScheme
axioms.evidence: a low-complexity spectrum sharing scheme is presented based on link-feature-sketching-aided hierarchical link clustering
